body: Addressed in `a6c74d928`: `changePassword` now revokes refresh sessions before writing `password_hash`, fails closed without updating the password if revocation fails, and keeps `password_changed` after the successful password write. Added regression coverage for revocation failure and post-revocation update failure.

Addressed in `a6c74d928`: `resetPassword` now revokes refresh sessions before resetting `password_hash`, fails closed without updating the password if revocation fails, and keeps `password_reset_completed` after the successful password write. Added regression coverage for both failure orders.

Addressed in `a6c74d928`: expired refresh tokens now return `200 AUTH_LOGOUT_SUCCESS` without attempting a session delete, while malformed and access-token logout attempts still return `401 AUTH_INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN`. Added regression coverage for both paths.
